name: Nha Trang
provinceNote: Khanh Hoa now includes the former Ninh Thuan province.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: Nha Trang is a beach city with a long municipal sand strip, island boat trips, and a mud-bath industry. Stay if you want the sea between Da Lat and the south. The city beach is busier and less wild than Phu Quoc.
fee: Beach is free; island tours are paid
getThere: Flights from Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, or a sleeper train and bus
seoDescription: When Nha Trang’s sea is calm, and what a two-day beach stop actually includes.
intro: The city beach runs along Tran Phu. Hotels face the sand, and the evenings belong to seafood rooms and the promenade. Islands in the bay are a boat day.
The Po Nagar Cham towers, just north of the center, are the historical stop and take under an hour.
gettingAround: The airport is a short ride from the beach. Grab works. Island boats leave from the tourist port; book the afternoon you want, not a harbor scramble.

stayAreas.name: Tran Phu beach
stayAreas.summary: The straightforward base, on the sand.

eat: Seafood by weight is the local risk and the local pleasure. Agree the price before it is grilled. Nem nuong is the snack to look for.
interestsBody: Beach first. Add an island or the Cham towers, then move on if you are collecting cities.
Resort living is Hon Tre island hotels and the boat-transfer villas in Ninh Van Bay.

interestCards.summary: Vinpearl on Hon Tre and Six Senses Ninh Van Bay.

interestCards.title: Beaches
interestCards.summary: Tran Phu sand in front of the hotel row.

faqs.a: The calmer months are roughly February to September. Winter surf and rain make the beach a walk more than a swim.
